protocol.scope: Exploratory source-only diagnosis of repeated P1 H1/H2 troughs; no production tuning or processed audio output.

analysis.complex_demodulation: Multiply original samples by exp(-j2pi*n*carrier*t), rationally downsample 48:1 to1kHz, then zero-phase sixth-order low-pass at8Hz. Preserve complex phase. Repeat12Hz cutoff for envelope robustness. This computes diagnostics only; no processed audio files are written.
models: one damped exponential with linear chirp
two damped exponentials sharing one frequency
analysis.fitting_limit: Descriptive parameter fits, not identified physical modes or a production calibration. Independent2s repicks censor trajectories; short-window Rayleigh scale and filter correlation must be reported. Check start-window sensitivity and near-coincident two-line ambiguity.
analysis.contact_diagnostic: Compare original high-band4-12kHz RMS with narrowband trough timing; retain frozen attenuation/contact flags and next-event guards.
analysis.model_read: Use separately frozen existing actual coupled poles and fresh-light exact bank dump. No model waveform affects source observer choices.

prohibited: no fitted production detune or gain
no dropped notes based on model error

exploratory_followup_protocol.status: Exploratory followup chosen after inspecting the first four descriptive models; not a preregistered hypothesis test.
exploratory_followup_protocol.reason: A same-frequency two-decay model already explains much of the P1 notch. A fixed-frequency doublet can absorb common pitch curvature, so compare against a no-split two-decay model with shared linear chirp at the same total parameter count.
exploratory_followup_protocol.data: Same all60 original-source complex trajectories and .2..1.8s fit interval, plus .35..1.8s and .2..1.4s sensitivity intervals.
exploratory_followup_protocol.limits: Both are low-dimensional descriptive surrogates. Residuals, parameter bounds, window sensitivity, and direct spectral resolution must be retained. Neither model identifies polarization, pickup force, contact, or bridge parameters. No production tuning.

four_model_fit_summary.scope: Descriptive source fits. Band-limited diagnostic samples are correlated; fit improvement is not a physical attribution or statistical confidence certificate.

limits: New strings are not zero-state releases: preceding string phases and ringing repicks remain; no NoteOff is identified.
The first29 interpick intervals are about2s. Fits do not observe a complete slow beat or long independent free decay.
Complex diagnostic samples are filtered and correlated. Residuals are descriptive, not independent-noise likelihoods or confidence intervals.
Unknown strike direction, physical contact force, pickup selector/height and magnetic gradients prevent attributing signed components to physical axes.
Some fits reach zero-damping parameter boundaries and vary under window changes. A constant two-line decomposition can absorb chirp or time-varying envelopes.
Retained P2 note5 has a frozen attenuation candidate beginning1.79335s, at the end of the full fit; no note or flagged window was dropped.
Current production scalar loss filters are individually phase-compensated at f0. Disabling that compensation would expose surrogate numerical phase, not establish measured body-admittance splitting.
No NC sample, production edit, new recording, listening comparison, or default parameter change is part of this qualification.
